text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Vivlos is hard at work training, her 
parents and Verxina drop by with some 
refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them was a gift from Cheval Grand, 
who continued to train all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos returns the favor through the 
Trainer so as not to disturb her. Upon 
receiving it, Cheval Grand entrusts the 
Trainer with a letter she had been 
hesitating to give.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's both do our best"――After reading 
the message, Vivlos dashed off to go see 
Cheval Grand in person.
